info.title: Sentinel AML API
info.description: Transaction monitoring: ingestion, rule-based detection, alerts and case management. Roles: ANALYST (queue & disposition), SUPERVISOR (+ full PII, case closure, reopen), ADMIN (+ ingestion, rule/watchlist/FX configuration).

tags.name: Reference data
tags.description: Exchange rates (base currency normalisation) and high-risk / sanctions watchlist

tags.name: Customers
tags.description: Customer lookup, accounts and transaction timeline

tags.name: Ingestion
tags.description: Bulk (JSON/CSV) and streaming ingestion of KYC, account and transaction data

tags.name: Accounts
tags.description: Account holds placed by the loss-prevention guardrails

tags.name: Dashboard
tags.description: Queue health, risk heatmap and analyst productivity metrics

tags.name: Alerts
tags.description: Analyst alert queue, evidence and disposition workflow

tags.name: Rules
tags.description: View and tune detection rules at runtime (no redeployment)

tags.name: Detection
tags.description: Operational controls for the detection engine

put.summary: Create or update the rate to the base currency (applies to transactions ingested afterwards)
put.description: Guardrail: a move of more than 10% is rejected with 422 FX_RATE_DEVIATION unless confirmLargeChange=true

post.summary: Streaming ingestion of a single transaction; evaluated synchronously and returns any alert raised
post.description: 400 invalid payload, 409 duplicate txnRef, 422 unknown account / unsupported currency

post.summary: Bulk load transactions from a JSON array, then run detection in parallel (detect=false to skip)
Bulk load transactions from CSV, then run detection in parallel (detect=false to skip)
Bulk upsert customers (KYC) from a JSON array; invalid rows are rejected individually
Bulk upsert customers from CSV (header row; camelCase or snake_case columns)
Bulk upsert accounts from a JSON array; customerRef must already exist
Evaluate every transaction not yet evaluated (loaded with detect=false, or after a failure)
Open a case from one or more alerts of the same customer (alerts become ESCALATED)
Move a case: INVESTIGATING | SAR_FILED (SUPERVISOR) | CLOSED (SUPERVISOR; closes escalated alerts)
post.description: 409 for a transition not allowed from the current status, 403 if the role is insufficient

post.summary: START_REVIEW | CLOSE (disposition + reason) | ESCALATE (reason, optional caseId) | REOPEN (SUPERVISOR)
post.description: 409 if the action is not allowed from the alert's current status; 422 if disposition/reason is missing

post.summary: Lift an automatic freeze (SUPERVISOR only, reason required, audited)
post.description: 409 if the account is not frozen

patch.summary: Activate / deactivate an entry (entries are never deleted, for auditability)
Toggle / re-weight / tune a rule. params are merged over the current ones and validated; 422 if invalid. Takes effect for the next evaluated transaction.

get.summary: All rules with current thresholds, weights and version
Every past version of a rule's configuration
Recent ingestion batches (from the audit log)
Rejected rows of a batch with the reason for each
Counts by status, rule x risk-band heatmap, 30-day trend and disposition metrics
Customers (PII masked), optionally filtered by reference prefix or KYC risk
Customer detail with accounts. Full PII only for SUPERVISOR/ADMIN (and audited)
Transaction timeline across all accounts, with the alerts each transaction is evidence for
Audit entries for one entity (e.g. entityType=ALERT&entityId=ALT-100001), or the latest 200
Alert queue (PII masked), highest risk first by default
Alert detail: explanation per rule, evidence transactions, customer (PII visible to SUPERVISOR+)
Immutable audit trail of this alert (creation, aggregation, every state transition)
Accounts by status (e.g. status=FROZEN for accounts frozen after a sanctions hit)
